description: Power up your projects with the RYOBI 18V ONE+ 4Ah Lithium HIGH PERFORMANCE EDGE Battery, featuring advanced tabless cell technology for superior performance. This innovative battery delivers up to 2X more power and 4X longer runtime thanks to its 21700 tabless cells working in harmony with INTELLICELL technology. The COOL-CORE PRO heat management system, equipped with laser-welded cell straps and upgraded heat sinks, keeps the battery running 25% cooler while extending its lifespan by 50%. Experience fade-free power and up to 43% faster cuts when paired with compatible tools like the Brushless 6-1/2" Circular Saw. Built tough with durable overmold and anti-vibration technology, this battery withstands demanding jobsite conditions. The clear LED fuel gauge helps you monitor remaining power at a glance. As part of the versatile ONE+ System, this battery works seamlessly with all RYOBI 18V ONE+ tools, making it a valuable addition to your power tool collection.
